# One command per line, run in order by .github/workflows/expo-upgrade.yml
# Batch 2: drop unused native/JS libraries, update plugins for SDK 58.
npm uninstall moti victory-native react-native-calendars react-native-worklets-core
npm install --save-exact @bacons/apple-targets@5.0.0
npx expo install @expo/config-plugins expo-alternate-app-icons@latest
npx expo install --check
npm view react-native-purchases@latest peerDependencies
npm view react-native-health@latest version
